issue: Control layer selectors rebuild and load thumbnails on unrelated layer and selection events

before.reproduction: Add several img2img, Vibe, Precise Reference, or other control layers, then modify a layer or draw/change a selection in Krita.
before.expected: Only controls affected by the event update. Stable layer selectors keep their current item without rebuilding, selection target calculation is coalesced, and thumbnails are loaded only when requested.
before.actual: Every ControlWidget connected to LayerManager.changed clears and rebuilds its combo, synchronously generates whole-canvas and per-layer thumbnails, and restores the selected item. Every ControlLayer also receives every selection-bounds event, while mode changes invoke the layer refresh twice.

adjacent_working_case: Adding, removing, moving, or renaming an actual image layer must still update selector contents; changing control mode must add/remove NAI special sources; selection img2img must still auto-calculate its target; concrete-layer controls must retain their selected layer.
hypothesis: Unconditional combo rebuilding, eager thumbnail generation, duplicate/untracked signal connections, and globally subscribed selection handlers cause the flicker and avoidable work.
disproof: The hypothesis is false if a stable layer-list signature still clears the combo or calls thumbnail(), if non-selection controls still receive selection events, or if selection bursts still emit repeated target changes without settling.
